significance_decision.reason: All five intended KPI values are present in the homepage source as counter data and render visibly for a normal JavaScript-enabled visitor. Their absence from static or indexed text is a technical accessibility defect, but it does not remove the metrics from the human buyer journey. No evidence establishes lost enquiries, buyer distrust or a wider KPI inconsistency.

evidence.claim: The homepage source contains five counter values: 20 years of operating experience, 130 thousand square metres managed, 1,000 occasional engagements, 800 satisfied clients and 120 subcontractors.
evidence.method: Read-only live HTML inspection of Kadence count-up elements and their data-end attributes.

evidence.claim: After JavaScript execution, all five counters are visible and populated with the same values in a rendered browser.
evidence.method: Read-only rendered DOM check after page load; no interaction or form submission.

evidence.claim: Static and indexed text exposes the five labels without the numbers because each counter's text node is initially empty and is populated by JavaScript.
evidence.method: Live HTML inspection plus current search-rendered page text.

evidence.claim: The homepage and services page expose no client references, testimonial text, certification detail or external proof links in the sampled rendered content.
evidence.method: Read-only rendered DOM inspection of the homepage and services page.
evidence.limitation: This is a bounded two-page observation and is not proof that Premier lacks offline references, client evidence or certifications.

evidence.claim: The site identifies Premier Facility Management Team and Otthonbiztonságban.hu Kft. together in the footer and publishes the legal entity on the services and contact surfaces.
evidence.method: Read-only rendered DOM and indexed-page review.
evidence.interpretation: The relationship could be explained more explicitly, but the sampled evidence does not support treating it as a material inconsistency.

commercial_decision.reason_offer_strategist_not_invoked: The KPI issue failed the significance gate. The remaining approved findings do not establish a sufficiently material, bounded problem to justify an offer.
commercial_decision.alternative_assessment: Limited third-party credibility proof is a real observation, but it is generic and does not show that Premier has usable proof ready to publish, a current buying trigger, or a commercially meaningful loss. The brand-to-legal-entity presentation is identifiable on the site and is not strong enough on its own.

artifact_decision.reason: A one-page artifact would magnify a minor rendering-accessibility defect or restate a generic proof absence. It would not materially strengthen responsible outreach.

exact_next_action: Keep Premier FM at diagnostic_complete with commercial_preparation_status hold_no_material_offer. Reopen only when fresh evidence establishes a substantive trust or conversion problem, a real buying signal, or supportable proof content that Premier is positioned to activate.
